items.claim: The entered-group frame projects through the pan/zoom form, so far from the origin it drifts off the group the canvas draws
The workspace tint's page cut-out projects through the pan/zoom form, so far from the origin the strips miss the page edge
A pose run whose `step` returns a lazy iterable that throws is left running forever with no frame coming
A view-marker drag projects the live world point through the target camera captured at press
`mergeVisibilityRules` writes user keys into a plain object, so a `__proto__` chrome id reassigns the prototype and its rule is lost
[r62? no — r42-9] createCanvasCamera.target() stale heading during a glide it didn't start
items.note: An earlier commit, f20931c24a, had fixed this for handles that expose `viewAnimationTarget`. The fallback path for handles without it was still wrong: a glide started over the camera's own glide cancels it without calling `onDone`, so `target()` kept returning the canceled heading. A test reproduced this before the fix. `PresentationCanvas` now requires `viewAnimationTarget()`, which `SceneCanvasApi` already has, and the camera no longer keeps a heading of its own. `createCanvasCamera` hasn't been released yet (it only appears in pending changesets), so making the method required breaks nobody. The pending `canvas-camera-stale-heading` changeset already describes this behavior, so I added no new one.

items.claim: a rule set to `undefined` replaces the kit default with "always visible"
items.note: The same spread also lost the preset's rule in `useChromeRules` (`useSceneChrome.ts`) and in the `chromeRules` dep. All three now merge through `mergeVisibilityRules`, which skips `undefined` values.

items.claim: createCanvasCamera keeps a stale glide target and reports it during someone else's glide
items.note: Adds `SceneCanvasApi.viewAnimationTarget()` (api changeset) and the optional `PresentationCanvas.viewAnimationTarget`, which the camera reads first. A handle without it clears the camera's heading through `onDone` once its own glide ends.

items.claim: present.go can't reach a page whose id is `'first'` or `'last'`
items.note:
I made the call and recorded it in `docs/unruled.md` under a new "Audit round forty-two" section:
  - `PageRequest` gains `{ end: 'first' | 'last' }`, and the Home/End step variants send it.
  - A `{ to }` now matches a page id before it is read as an end, so old `{ to: 'first' }` callers still work.

items.claim: arrivalBounds applies its 24 px cascade in world units
items.note:
`IngestCtx` and the `ingestion` dep gain an optional `worldPerPx()`, signed so a flipped view steps down on screen.
  - `<SceneCanvas>` and `<CanvasView>` supply it.
  - The editing ingest action and the drop ghost pass it on.

items.claim: a `usePoseRun` step that throws leaves the run stuck as running
enteredGroupScope only bumps its version while someone is subscribed
the `chromeRules` dep's `get` also read ids through `Object.prototype`
